local FX = _G.FX
local FXLoader = FX.Loader
local CAuraShopPreview = FX.Class("CAuraShopPreview", "CAuraShopView")

-- 准备多条光环与品质颜色，演示固定窗口中的滚动列表，只用于本地模拟。
-- @param owner table 编辑器宿主。
function CAuraShopPreview:Ctor(owner)
    CAuraShopPreview.Super.Ctor(self, owner)
    self.Config = {
        title = "AURAS",
        qualities = {
            common = {name = "Common", color = "#FAFCF9"},
            rare = {name = "Rare", color = "#73BBEF"},
            epic = {name = "Epic", color = "#BC85E5"},
            legendary = {name = "Legendary", color = "#F4BF52"},
        },
        auras = {
            {id = "calm", name = "Calm Aura", qualityId = "common", strength = 1, price = 0},
            {id = "spark", name = "Spark Aura", qualityId = "rare", strength = 8, price = 700},
            {id = "breeze", name = "Breeze Aura", qualityId = "common", strength = 3, price = 350},
            {id = "frost", name = "Frost Aura", qualityId = "rare", strength = 12, price = 1200},
            {id = "storm", name = "Storm Aura", qualityId = "rare", strength = 18, price = 1800},
            {id = "flame", name = "Flame Aura", qualityId = "epic", strength = 25, price = 2500},
            {id = "shadow", name = "Shadow Aura", qualityId = "epic", strength = 35, price = 3500},
            {id = "radiant", name = "Radiant Aura", qualityId = "epic", strength = 50, price = 5000},
            {id = "celestial", name = "Celestial Aura", qualityId = "legendary", strength = 75, price = 7500},
            {id = "dragon", name = "Dragon Aura", qualityId = "legendary", strength = 100, price = 10000},
        },
    }
    self.State = {
        owned = {calm = true, breeze = true, dragon = true},
        equippedId = "calm",
        coins = 700,
        open = true,
    }
end

-- 绑定展示后刷新。
function CAuraShopPreview:OnReady()
    CAuraShopPreview.Super.OnReady(self)
    self:BindUIData()
    self:Show()
end

-- 模拟购买与装备成功，正式游戏必须替换为服务端结果。
-- @param action string Buy、Equip 或 Close。
-- @param payload table 稳定 auraId，Close 为空表。
function CAuraShopPreview:OnUIAction(action, payload)
    if action == "Close" then
        self.State.open = false
    elseif action == "Buy" then
        for index, aura in ipairs(self.Config.auras) do
            if aura.id == payload.auraId and not self.State.owned[aura.id] and self.State.coins >= aura.price then
                self.State.coins = self.State.coins - aura.price
                self.State.owned[aura.id] = true
            end
        end
    elseif action == "Equip" then
        if self.State.owned[payload.auraId] then
            self.State.equippedId = payload.auraId
        end
    end
    self:RefreshUI()
end

return CAuraShopPreview

--[[
光环列表接入契约（完整状态，非增量）
Config.title: string，必填标题。
Config.qualities: 字典，键为品质 ID；值 {name: string, color: string} 均必填，color 为 #RRGGBB 卡片底色。
Config.auras: 数组，显示顺序；每项 {id: string, name: string, qualityId: string,
 strength: number, price: number, icon: string?}。前五项必填；price 单位金币，strength 为加成点数；
 id 唯一稳定，qualityId 对应 qualities 键；icon 可选 Roblox 图片 ID，缺省或空字符串显示问号占位。
State.owned: 字典，auraId -> boolean，缺省键表示未拥有。
State.equippedId: string，必填，空字符串表示未装备。
State.coins: number，必填，可用金币；State.open: boolean，必填。
State.pending: 字典，可选，auraId -> boolean，缺省为未请求；State.loading: boolean? 缺省 false。
最小示例：
 self.Config = {title="AURAS", qualities={common={name="Common",color="#FAFCF9"}},
 auras={{id="calm",name="Calm Aura",qualityId="common",strength=1,price=0}}}
 self.State = {owned={calm=true},equippedId="calm",coins=700,open=true}
GetUIConfig/GetUIState 默认读取 self.Config/self.State。首次 Show 前准备全部必填数据；
接入 OnReady 先父 OnReady，再 BindUIData、Show；后续更新数据后 RefreshUI。
RefreshUI 调用 Render(GetUIState())；列表空时显示空提示，loading=true 时显示加载提示并清空条目。
动作：Buy / Equip，payload={auraId:string}；Close，payload={}。无返回值。
必需覆写 OnUIAction，负责服务端校验、扣款及装备，请求时设置 pending[id]，完成后更新完整状态并刷新。
无其他页面专用覆写。UI 禁用不代表服务器校验。模拟 integration 不导入游戏。
AuraIconImg 是动态图占位，正式图由 Config.auras[].icon 替换；
App 动态 ID 预览能力有限，真实资源权限及 Studio 显示需另验。
]]
local FX = _G.FX
local FXLoader = FX.Loader
local CAuraShopView = FX.Class("CAuraShopView", "CUIView")

-- 绑定窗口与隐藏原型，只在首次准备时连接关闭按钮。
function CAuraShopView:OnReady()
    local root = FXLoader:PlayerGui("AuraShopUI")
    self.Root = root
    self.Panel = FXLoader:Here(root, "PopupPanelImg")
    self.TitleBox = FXLoader:Here(root, "TitleBox")
    self.TitleTxt = FXLoader:Here(root, "TitleBox.TitleTxt")
    self.List = FXLoader:Here(root, "PopupPanelImg.AuraListBox")
    self.EmptyTxt = FXLoader:Here(root, "PopupPanelImg.EmptyTxt")
    self.Template = FXLoader:Here(root, "Templates.AuraRowImg")
    self.Rows = {}
    local closeBtn = FXLoader:Here(root, "TitleBox.CloseSurfaceImg.CloseBtn")
    self:TrackConnection(closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
        self:EmitUIAction("Close", {})
    end))
end

-- 打开时应用当前完整数据。
function CAuraShopView:OnShow()
    self:RefreshUI()
end

-- 根据稳定 ID 增删和更新条目，颜色始终从品质配置读取。
-- @param state table 完整状态，字段见文件头。
function CAuraShopView:Render(state)
    local config = self:GetUIConfig()
    self.Panel.Visible = state.open
    self.TitleBox.Visible = state.open
    self.TitleTxt.Text = config.title
    local active = {}
    local count = 0
    if not state.loading then
        for index, aura in ipairs(config.auras) do
            count = index
            active[aura.id] = true
            local entry = self.Rows[aura.id]
            if not entry then
                local row = self.Template:Clone()
                row.Name = "Aura_" .. aura.id
                row.Parent = self.List
                row.Visible = true
                local button = FXLoader:Here(row, "ActionBtn")
                local auraId = aura.id
                -- 每个实例只连接一次；点击时读取当前状态，以稳定 ID 发出动作。
                local connection = self:TrackConnection(button.Activated:Connect(function()
                    local currentState = self:GetUIState()
                    local action = "Buy"
                    if currentState.owned[auraId] then
                        action = "Equip"
                    end
                    self:EmitUIAction(action, {auraId = auraId})
                end))
                local release = self:TrackCleanup(function()
                    connection:Disconnect()
                    row:Destroy()
                end)
                entry = {row = row, button = button, release = release}
                self.Rows[aura.id] = entry
            end
            local row = entry.row
            local quality = config.qualities[aura.qualityId]
            row.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, (index - 1) * 172 + 2)
            row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHex(quality.color)
            FXLoader:Here(row, "NameTxt").Text = aura.name
            FXLoader:Here(row, "RarityTxt").Text = quality.name
            FXLoader:Here(row, "StrengthTxt").Text = "Strength +" .. tostring(aura.strength)
            local icon = FXLoader:Here(row, "AuraIconImg")
            icon.Image = aura.icon or "rbxassetid://86795093617566"
            local owned = state.owned[aura.id] == true
            local equipped = state.equippedId == aura.id
            local pending = state.pending and state.pending[aura.id]
            local caption = tostring(aura.price) .. " Coins"
            local color = "#67ED14"
            local edge = "#225A07"
            if owned then
                caption = "Equip"
            end
            if equipped then
                caption = "Equipped"
                color = "#397BA7"
                edge = "#193E73"
            elseif pending then
                caption = "Waiting..."
                color = "#638079"
            elseif not owned and state.coins < aura.price then
                caption = "Need " .. tostring(aura.price)
                color = "#638079"
            end
            FXLoader:Here(row, "OwnedTxt").Visible = false
            FXLoader:Here(row, "ActionBtn.ButtonTxt").Text = caption
            FXLoader:Here(row, "ActionBtn.BottomEdgeImg").BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHex(edge)
            entry.button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHex(color)
            self:SetButtonEnabled(entry.button, not equipped and not pending and (owned or state.coins >= aura.price))
        end
    end
    for auraId, entry in pairs(self.Rows) do
        if not active[auraId] then
            entry.release()
            self.Rows[auraId] = nil
        end
    end
    self.List.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, math.max(524, count * 172))
    self.EmptyTxt.Visible = count == 0
    self.EmptyTxt.Text = "No auras available"
    if state.loading then
        self.EmptyTxt.Text = "Loading..."
    end
end

-- 必须由游戏接入或模拟类处理业务动作。
-- @param action string Buy、Equip 或 Close。
-- @param payload table auraId 或空表。
function CAuraShopView:OnUIAction(action, payload)
    error("Aura shop integration must implement OnUIAction")
end

return CAuraShopView
